objective: Real guided Engine OS installation before the M7 desktop and M8 MS-DOS/Windows 1.x-11 applications
requirements: Native graphical Back/Next/Finish wizard with keyboard, USB mouse and PS/2 mouse
Capacity-aware verified disk installation, independent boot and persistent files larger than 48 KiB
Retained customization, user profile/accent, independent optional guide removal and working distro recipe
Distinct-build update, rollback and ISO-assisted boot recovery with unchanged data
Cancellation/refusal, real write/activation faults, integrity checks and recovery boundaries
Bounded RAM, no allocation growth during navigation and CPU halt at input idle
English current documentation, official versioned artifacts and exact digest-bound evidence
limits: Named virtual firmware/controllers only; no universal or physical hardware certification
No target hotplug or disk changes during an operation
1024 file/directory entries; 255-byte paths; contiguous extents and copy-on-write workspace
Single local profile; no authentication, ACLs or untrusted app-file services
ISO repair can be needed after interrupted boot replay; no automatic A/B bootloader failover
Same layout/volume ABI for update and rollback; no migration of M5/M5.1 ext2 development disks
No desktop or Windows/MS-DOS execution runtime
qualification: evidence/M6/acceptance-results.json must pass for the exact released bytes
